channel.title: RNZ Business Headlines
channel.description: The Latest Business headlines from RNZ News

item.title: RNZ Asia, business and technology teams face cuts as fallout continues
item.description: It comes after news rural reporters have also received change proposals.

item.title: NZ burying valuable energy source in landfills, biogas company says
item.description: Ecogas wants to see more waste collection with 622,000 tonnes of food put into landfill each year according to a government report.

item.title: Farmers staff set to strike over wage negotiations impasse
item.description: A union says some of the workers are receiving some of the lowest wages in the retail sector.

item.title: Designs for Kiwirail's new Cook Strait ferries unveiled
item.description: The two hybrid ferries will have more space for vehicles and passengers, and better fuel efficiency.

item.title: RNZ continuing to manage attempted cyber breach
item.description: A spokesperson said the technology team was working with specialist cyber security support providers to monitor its impact and find solutions.
